name: Endless Tricks
author: Skate Rust Engine
description: Hold a kickflip, heelflip, 360 flip or laserflip and keep going for as long as the air lasts, up to sixteen. Not a Skate 3 trick: retail stops at four. Needs real height off a ledge or a ramp; a flat pop still stops at a double. Owns native trainer tuning, so it cannot run alongside the Native Trainer.

enabled.label: Endless flips
enabled.description: Off restores the stock four-rung ladder exactly.

max_flips.label: Maximum flips
max_flips.description: Most flips one pop may reach. 4 is the stock quad; from the 9th on it is just called ENDLESS.

require_air.label: Require air for each flip
require_air.description: Off (default) keeps flipping while you hold and stay off the ground, with no height needed. On only starts a flip it has the air to land out of, so you bail less and flip less.

hud.label: Show status
hud.description: Small on-screen reminder of the current limit.
